g.text: Ariel System — Low-Latency Request & Durable Event Processing Flow
Phase 1: Ultra-Low Latency Synchronous Ingestion & Validation (< 15ms P99)
Check Rate Limit & JWT Blacklist (Redis Lua Script)
Phase 2: Asynchronous Durable Event Streaming & Large Data Handling
Async Batch Insert into ScyllaDB (Time-Series Log)
Update Materialized View & Rolling Aggregations in Redis
Publish to `ariel.dlq` with Error Headers & Alert OTel
